caption: The drawing depicts a standing figure facing left. The figure is dressed in a tan or brown knee-length garment with short sleeves, over which is draped a red cloth with a gold border. The figure is barefoot and wears light-colored sandals. On the head is a dark headband adorned with three large, multicolored feathers in shades of brown, pink, and green. The hair is dark and long, extending past the shoulders. The figure is holding a bundle of cigars in the left hand, while the right hand secures a rectangular sign against the hip reading “FINE CIGARS.” The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, and the overall style is detailed and softly colored, using a palette that includes reds, browns, greens, pinks, and golds.
